input: Research clinical trials for my chronic condition

gold.taskTitle: Research Clinical Trials for My Chronic Condition
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate relevant clinical trials available for the user's specific chronic medical condition.

questions.title: What specific chronic condition are you researching trials for?
questions.description: Identify the exact medical condition or diagnosis to target the search accurately.

questions.title: What is your primary goal in joining a trial?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants access to new treatments, compensation, contributing to research, or something else.

questions.title: What country and city are you located in?
questions.description: Location determines which trials are geographically accessible or require travel.

questions.title: Are you currently on any medications or treatments for this condition?
questions.description: Current treatments may affect eligibility criteria for many clinical trials.

questions.title: What phase of clinical trial are you open to?
questions.description: Different phases carry different risk levels and purposes, from safety testing to efficacy confirmation.

questions.title: Do you have a specific timeline for enrolling in a trial?
questions.description: Knowing urgency helps prioritize actively recruiting trials versus upcoming ones.

questions.title: Will your doctor be involved in evaluating trial options?
questions.description: Determines whether the research needs to be patient-facing only or also suitable for a medical professional to review.
